capabilities: Render pseudocode from LaTeX-style syntax in pseudo code blocks
Insert pseudocode blocks with a dedicated command
Customize macros via a preamble file or in-block preamble
Export a compilable LaTeX file with required macros to the clipboard
intentEvidence: This is a plugin for Obsidian that allows you to render LaTeX-style pseudocode inside a code block.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to typeset algorithmic pseudocode with LaTeX-style grammar, math formulas, and print-quality output.

relations.evidence: The plugin is based on pseudocode.js, a JavaScript library that typesets pseudocode beautifully to HTML.

summary: Plugin that renders LaTeX-style pseudocode inside code blocks, typeset to publication-quality HTML via pseudocode.js.
